title: A report of every answered decision: what was asked, what was chosen, and what the other options would have cost
name: why-report
description: The charter's education pillar: the user finishes knowing why every decision was made, what the alternatives were and what each would have cost later. `sober decisions --all` (packages/cli/src/index.ts → `decisions`) lists what was chosen, but not the options that were not taken, their reasons and later costs, the `derived` provenance, or which nodes the answer released. Add a report that renders all of that as one markdown document, in the order the decisions were answered. CLI: prints to stdout. Dashboard: the decisions screen (apps/dashboard/src/decisions/) gets a button that copies or downloads the same markdown — one renderer in core, both surfaces call it.

brief.approach: Create a single read-only Markdown renderer in packages/core/src/report.ts that takes loadBoard(paths), selects answered decisions, sorts by answer timestamp (with id as stable tie-breaker), and writes each question, chosen option and rationale, derived provenance, every unchosen option with reason and costLater, and the bound node names/ids it released. Escape Markdown text from board records so one answer cannot break report structure. Export the renderer from packages/core/src/index.ts. Add `sober why` (or `sober decisions --report`) in packages/cli/src/index.ts to print that exact string to stdout. Expose the same string via a read-only packages/server/src/routes.ts operation and wire a Copy Markdown button into apps/dashboard/src/decisions/Decisions.tsx; do not duplicate formatting in the browser. Update schema and surface coverage only for the new operation. Test ordering, alternatives, empty board, escaping and the CLI/server/dashboard path with focused tests.

acceptance.run: pnpm exec vitest run packages/core/src/report.test.ts apps/dashboard/src/decisions/data.test.ts
acceptance.proves: Report ordering, complete alternatives, provenance, node bindings and empty output are deterministic.

acceptance.run: pnpm exec vitest run --project integration test/integration/cli.test.ts test/integration/contract.test.ts
acceptance.proves: CLI and dashboard/server surfaces expose the same core Markdown report.

acceptance.run: pnpm build && pnpm exec biome check packages/core/src/report.ts packages/core/src/index.ts packages/cli/src/index.ts packages/server/src/routes.ts apps/dashboard/src/decisions test/integration/cli.test.ts test/integration/contract.test.ts
acceptance.proves: Touched core, CLI and dashboard paths compile and pass style checks.

plain.what: Add one Markdown report of answered decisions, including choices, alternatives, costs and affected nodes, available from CLI and dashboard.
plain.why: The current decisions list names the choice but leaves out the reasoning and rejected options needed to understand it later.
plain.check: Run focused report, CLI and contract tests plus build and style checks.
plain.risk: Board text must be escaped before Markdown output; the renderer is shared so CLI and dashboard cannot drift.
